title: pilosella stoloniflora subsp. schuriana
intro: Pilosella stoloniflora subsp. schuriana, commonly known as a type of dandelion, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella stoloniflora subsp. schuriana include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
